verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Twilio's messaging APIs for sending SMS, MMS, RCS and WhatsApp, plus developer primitives such as Sync and Event Streams. Nothing in the pack describes a shared team inbox where inbound texts land and the team can see which agent replied. Those APIs and primitives are developer building blocks for constructing such an inbox, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied
